_description: Gistify-style benchmark tasks. Each entry describes a test-case-per-repo that our tool must reduce while preserving output. Modeled on the Gistify paper (Lee et al., ICLR 2026, arXiv 2510.26790) — same repos, same evaluation shape, but a custom test selection because the paper's exact 25-test list isn't publicly released.
_evaluation_note: Execution Fidelity per Gistify: 1 iff runs(c, G) AND out(c, G) = out(c, C). Success = 1 if the reduced project still runs the same test command with the same output (after our validator's normalize step).
_test_selection_criteria: Pure-Python tests (no network, no fixtures needing a running service) that exercise a bounded slice of the codebase. Kept intentionally small so the harness runs in reasonable time on a laptop.

tasks.notes: Exercises requests.utils.super_len — the len() variant that handles partially-read file objects.
